title: Create baseline Make help and install/doctor shell entrypoints
description:
Create the baseline operator surface: a Makefile that delegates to the CLI, a minimal CLI with help/install-check/doctor, and a README that identifies the complete product.

mike_trade/cli.py: implement `main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int` using argparse (stdlib) unless a CLI library is already declared in pyproject.toml. Provide subcommands: `version` (prints mike_trade.__version__) and `doctor` (local, read-only checks: Python >= 3.12; mike_trade package importable; required dependency imports resolvable; the state directory path is resolvable and gitignored; whether credential environment variables are present, reported only as present/absent without printing values; and the resolved default mode, which must not be LIVE). `doctor` exits 0 when all required checks pass and nonzero otherwise, and makes no network or broker calls. Any future live-mutating command must require an explicit live confirmation flag; document this in --help text for the root parser. Use mike_trade.observability.logging and typed errors from mike_trade.domain.errors.

Makefile: `.DEFAULT_GOAL := help`; a `help` target that lists targets with one-line descriptions (self-documenting via `##` comments); `install` (runs `uv sync --frozen` including dev tooling); `doctor` (runs `uv run mike-trade doctor`); `version`. Recipes delegate to uv or the CLI only and contain no business logic. Do not add live-trading targets in this phase.

README.md: identify mike_trade as a complete, production-grade, operator-supervised trading application (not a demo). Summarize the modes (BACKTEST, SHADOW, PAPER, LIVE), state that LIVE is explicitly gated and never triggered by importing modules, reading status, or running tests, give quickstart steps (`make install`, `make doctor`, `make help`), point to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and the ADR, and state that secrets live in environment/untracked files and are never committed. Make no profitability claims.

Before editing, inspect:
- pyproject.toml (console script name and dependencies) and uv.lock presence (from a.1)
- mike_trade/observability/logging.py and mike_trade/domain/errors.py (from a.2)
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (from a.3)
- mike_trade/app.py and mike_trade/runtime.py (from a.4) for ExecutionMode and settings
- .gitignore (read-only) for the state directory entry
acceptance_criteria: Running `make` with no target prints the help listing, which includes help, install, doctor, and version
Makefile recipes only invoke uv and/or the mike-trade CLI; they contain no inline Python business logic
The Makefile defines no live-trading or order-placing targets
mike_trade/cli.py defines main(argv=None) -> int with version and doctor subcommands
`mike-trade version` prints a value equal to mike_trade.__version__
`mike-trade doctor` reports each check with a pass/fail status, exits 0 when all required checks pass, and exits nonzero on failure
doctor reports credential environment variables only as present/absent and never prints their values
doctor performs no network or broker calls and never resolves LIVE as the default mode

README.md describes the product as complete and operator-supervised, lists the four modes, states that LIVE is explicitly gated, gives make install/doctor/help quickstart steps, and links to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
README.md contains no secrets and no profitability claims
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
edit pyproject.toml or uv.lock (owned by a.1)
put business logic in Makefile recipes
add live-trading, order, or flatten targets in this phase
run broad test suites, backtests, or create broker orders
